nodes.label: Home
nodes.purpose: Landing page that introduces the brand, featured recipes, and seasonal content.
nodes.implementation: SSR page with hero, search prompt, featured collections, and personalized modules.

nodes.label: Recipes
nodes.purpose: Browse and filter the full recipe library.
nodes.implementation: Server-rendered index backed by search facets, sort options, and pagination.

nodes.label: Recipe Detail
nodes.purpose: Display a single recipe with ingredients, steps, timing, and related content.
nodes.implementation: Dynamic route with structured content blocks and analytics events.

nodes.label: Profile
nodes.purpose: Show saved recipes, preferences, and meal plans.
nodes.implementation: Authenticated dashboard view with local settings and user-specific data.

nodes.label: Hero Assembly
nodes.purpose: Combines headline, search prompt, CTA, and featured image for the home page.
nodes.implementation: Composable container that wires analytics, layout, and responsive slots.

nodes.label: Featured Recipes
nodes.purpose: Presents a curated set of recipe cards for quick exploration.
nodes.implementation: Grid assembly that fetches recipe summaries and renders card variants.

nodes.label: Filter Bar
nodes.purpose: Lets visitors filter by diet, cook time, cuisine, and difficulty.
nodes.implementation: Sticky control row synced to query state and faceted search params.

nodes.label: Results Grid
nodes.purpose: Displays recipe cards after search or filtering.
nodes.implementation: Virtualized grid with pagination fallback and responsive columns.

nodes.label: Recipe Overview
nodes.purpose: Combines title, hero media, metadata, and quick actions.
nodes.implementation: Top content assembly using structured recipe data and media assets.

nodes.label: Instructions Block
nodes.purpose: Groups ingredients, steps, notes, and nutrition content.
nodes.implementation: Sectioned container with anchors and semantic content rendering.

nodes.label: Saved Recipes
nodes.purpose: Shows bookmarked or favorited recipes for the current user.
nodes.implementation: User-specific listing with cache-aware fetching and empty states.

nodes.label: Meal Planner
nodes.purpose: Supports weekly planning and shopping list generation.
nodes.implementation: Interactive planner backed by saved recipes and user preferences.

nodes.label: Search Input
nodes.purpose: Free-text search entry for recipe lookup.
nodes.implementation: Controlled input with debounced updates and keyboard support.

nodes.label: CTA Button
nodes.purpose: Primary action button used for exploration and conversion.
nodes.implementation: Shared button component with visual variants and tracking hooks.

nodes.label: Recipe Card
nodes.purpose: Compact summary for a recipe with image, title, and metadata.
nodes.implementation: Reusable card component used in multiple assemblies and pages.

nodes.label: Filter Chip
nodes.purpose: Displays an active or selectable filter option.
nodes.implementation: Small interactive chip component tied to search facet state.

nodes.label: Sort Select
nodes.purpose: Lets users change sorting such as newest or fastest.
nodes.implementation: Shared dropdown component with accessible listbox behavior.

nodes.label: Ingredient List
nodes.purpose: Renders ingredients with quantities and optional unit scaling.
nodes.implementation: Semantic list component with quantity formatting helpers.

nodes.label: Step List
nodes.purpose: Shows the ordered recipe instructions for cooking.
nodes.implementation: Ordered content renderer with timer and completion affordances.

nodes.label: Rating Stars
nodes.purpose: Shows community rating and review count.
nodes.implementation: Compact display component with average score formatting.

nodes.label: Save Toggle
nodes.purpose: Allows users to save or unsave a recipe.
nodes.implementation: Optimistic mutation component with auth guard and state sync.

nodes.label: Calendar Grid
nodes.purpose: Visual week planner for meal scheduling.
nodes.implementation: Drag-friendly layout component backed by planner state.

nodes.label: Shopping List
nodes.purpose: Aggregates ingredients across selected meals.
nodes.implementation: Grouped checklist component with pantry-aware grouping.
